verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that CRA has a delegated-access model. Representatives must request online access through the Represent a Client portal, account holders can 'authorize access to online information', and EFILE transmitters can file clients' returns. None of it publishes the actual scope of what a third party may or may not do. Missing for 10: named authorization forms, defined representative roles or authorization levels, a statement of which signatures or declarations must remain personal to the taxpayer, and any detailed first-party documentation of delegation limits.
